svg.aria-label: Career Services Portal: full-stack internship and career platform
svg.title: Career Services Portal: full-stack internship and career platform
svg.desc: Flutter student app and an HTML admin panel both call an Express API backed by PostgreSQL.
svg.text: Internships and applications, end to end
Students find internships, apply with a PDF or Word
resume and book interviews from an interactive
calendar. A separate admin web panel manages
One REST API serves both clients.
